# Renaissance — Renaissance of the Poor Soul

> A spiritual memoir by Halalisani Ngema about suffering, waiting, and finding rest. Biblical reflections on resilience, faith, and the transformation of the poor soul. Available as an ebook, paperback and PDF.

## About

Renaissance publishes spiritual writing by Halalisani Ngema: biblical reflections on the renaissance of the poor soul, suffering, affliction, waiting, shame, healing from failure, resilience and faith.
